title: Derived direct image along a qcqs morphism preserves quasi-coherent cohomology
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Then the derived direct image $Rf_*:D(\mathcal O_X)\to D(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] sends the full subcategory $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ of complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves [def-pc-derived-category] into $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$.

proof.text: Let $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ and fix an affine open $V=\operatorname{Spec}(A)\subseteq Y$; put $U=f^{-1}(V)$ and $f_V:U\to V$, again quasi-compact and quasi-separated (a base change of $f$ along an open immersion). Choose a K-injective resolution $E\to I$; by [lem-sc-derived-k-injective-restrict-open] $I|_U$ is K-injective, and $(f_*I)|_V=(f_V)_*(I|_U)$ termwise, so $(Rf_*E)|_V\cong Rf_{V*}(E|_U)$ and, restriction being exact, $\mathcal H^q(Rf_*E)|_V\cong\mathcal H^q(Rf_{V*}(E|_U))$. Also $E|_U\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_U)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Fix an integer $q$. Since $V$ is quasi-compact, [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-uniform-truncation-bound] for $f_V$ gives an integer $n$ (depending on $q$) such that $\mathcal H^q(Rf_{V*}(E|_U))\to\mathcal H^q(Rf_{V*}\tau_{\geq -n}(E|_U))$ is an isomorphism. The complex $K=\tau_{\geq -n}(E|_U)$ is bounded below with $\mathcal H^j(K)=0$ for $j<-n$, so [thm-sp-truncation-e2] applies to $v=f_{V*}$ with $a=-n$ (its $Rv$ on $D^+$ is $Rf_{V*}$, both computed by K-injective resolutions [def-pc-derived-direct-image]) and gives a spectral sequence with $E_2^{p,j}=R^p(f_V)_*\mathcal H^j(K)$, where $\mathcal H^j(K)=\mathcal H^j(E)|_U$ for $j\geq -n$ and $0$ for $j<-n$, converging to $\mathcal H^{p+j}(Rf_{V*}K)$ with a finite filtration (clauses 3, 5, 6). Each $\mathcal H^j(K)$ is quasi-coherent, so [lem-pc-finite-support-hi](1) for $f_V$ makes every $E_2^{p,j}$ quasi-coherent.

proof.text: In total degree $q$, clause 5 of [thm-sp-truncation-e2] gives a finite filtration $0=F^{q+n+1}H^q\subseteq\dots\subseteq F^0H^q=H^q:=\mathcal H^q(Rf_{V*}K)$ and clause 6 gives $\operatorname{gr}^pH^q\cong E_\infty^{p,q-p}=E_{r_0}^{p,q-p}$, obtained from the quasi-coherent $E_2^{p,q-p}$ by finitely many passages $E_{r+1}=\ker d_r/\operatorname{im}d_r$ with $d_r$ maps between quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_V$-modules. Kernels, images and cokernels of maps of quasi-coherent modules are quasi-coherent ([lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-kernel], [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-cokernel-image](2)), so every $E_\infty^{p,q-p}$, hence every $\operatorname{gr}^pH^q$, is quasi-coherent; by descending induction on $p$, using [lem-pc-quasi-coherent-extension] on the short exact sequences $0\to F^{p+1}H^q\to F^pH^q\to\operatorname{gr}^pH^q\to0$, $H^q$ is quasi-coherent. By Step 1, $\mathcal H^q(Rf_*E)|_V\cong H^q$ is quasi-coherent. Since the affine opens $V$ cover $Y$ and quasi-coherence is local, $\mathcal H^q(Rf_*E)$ is quasi-coherent for every $q$, i.e. $Rf_*E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category].
